**Release fix for v0.10.0 and v0.10.1.** Both stopped at the Homebrew step: the cask token template was not the bare `{{ .Env.NAME }}` GoReleaser requires, and the error only appears once the tap token is set. Their binaries, checksums, signatures and images were published, but the Homebrew cask and the Helm chart were not. v0.10.2 is the same code with the template fixed, so it publishes all of them.

### Pod side

- **Nothing to change.** Use chart `0.10.2` (`oci://ghcr.io/james-tronai/charts/hermes-email`, or Git `charts/hermes-email` at `v0.10.2`); there is no chart 0.10.0 or 0.10.1.

### What v0.10.0 added

- **`email mcp`**: the mailbox operations as MCP tools over stdio or Streamable HTTP (bearer token, loopback by default), through the same policy, audit log and UNTRUSTED body fencing. See [docs/mcp.md](https://github.com/james-tronai/email-cli/blob/v0.10.2/docs/mcp.md) and the [v0.10.0 notes](https://github.com/james-tronai/email-cli/releases/tag/v0.10.0).
- **Homebrew**: `brew install james-tronai/tap/email`.
